question: In the reaction MnO₂ + 4HCl → MnCl₂ + 2H₂O + Cl₂ :

options.text: Mn does not undergo redox reaction

solution:
The correct answer is **'MnO2**** is reduced to MnCl₂**'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• A REDOX reaction is where **oxidation and reduction occur simultaneously in a reaction**.
 
• 
 
 The reaction in which oxygen is either gained or hydrogen is lost by a substance is called oxidation reaction.The reaction in which hydrogen is gained or oxygen is lost by a substance is called reduction reaction.

 
 
• 
 
A substance is oxidised when: It gains Oxygen.

 
 
• It loses Hydrogen.
